content.brief:
The Allied and German air forces are looking for a dogfight to establish ownership of the sky between Montfaucon and Etain.
Kill as many enemy aircraft as possible in 30 minutes
The first team to reach 30 kills wins.
content.title: Air Combat Dogfight
